_readme: Small bits of site text, editable from the admin page (reachakash.com/admin, 'Site text'). _build/build.js puts them into the pages. announcement: an optional one-line banner at the top of every page (leave empty for none); announcementLink: where the banner links (optional, a site path like /services or a full https:// address). homeTagline: the line under the name on Home. personalBio: the first paragraph on /personal.
